description: Java source file defining the BasePage class for Selenium WebDriver automation. It provides reusable utilities for explicit waits, element interactions, navigation, and element validation tailored for testing the OrangeHRM web application.

classes.name: BasePage
classes.description: A Selenium page object providing reusable utilities for interacting with web pages, including explicit waits, element operations, navigation, validation, and screenshot capture.

methods.name: getWait
methods.description: Returns a WebDriverWait instance with the specified timeout.

methods.name: navigateTo
methods.description: Navigates to a relative URL path based on the base URL from configuration.

methods.name: navigateToAbsolute
methods.description: Navigates to an absolute URL.

methods.name: waitForVisible
methods.description: Waits for an element to be visible, given a locator.

methods.name: waitForVisible (with timeout)
methods.description: Waits for an element to be visible with a custom timeout.

methods.name: waitForClickable
methods.description: Waits for an element to be clickable.

methods.name: waitForAllVisible
methods.description: Waits for all elements matching a locator to be visible.

methods.name: waitForPresence
methods.description: Waits for an element to be present in the DOM.

methods.name: isElementDisplayed
methods.description: Checks if an element is displayed on the page.

methods.name: isElementVisible
methods.description: Checks if an element becomes visible within a given timeout.

methods.name: clearAndType
methods.description: Clears an input field and types provided text.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks an element after waiting for it to be clickable.

methods.name: getText
methods.description: Retrieves the trimmed text content of an element.

methods.name: getCurrentUrl
methods.description: Returns the current page URL.

methods.name: waitForUrlContains
methods.description: Waits until the URL contains a specific fragment.

methods.name: findOxdInputByLabel
methods.description: Finds an input element associated with a label text within OXD component groups.

methods.name: getInputValidationError
methods.description: Retrieves the validation error message for a specific input group.

methods.name: clickButtonByText
methods.description: Clicks a button identified by its visible text.

methods.name: waitForToast
methods.description: Waits for a toast notification of a specific type with expected message.

methods.name: waitForPageLoad
methods.description: Waits for the main page content area to be loaded and visible.

methods.name: takeScreenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the current page as a byte array.
